modules.module_title: Manage inventory for cleaning and guest supplies

pcs.pc_description: maintain adequate inventory of cleaning material like mops, brushes, cleaning agent etc.
check availability of adequate quantity of supplies like teabags, cookies, minibar items, water, toiletries in assigned areas
report any material/supply shortages to supervisor immediately
maintain inventory record as per specified format
maintain cleanliness of the store room at all times
inspect the assigned area to be cleaned
identify the types of surfaces to be cleaned
identify the appropriate cleaning agent as per the requirement
arrange cleaning equipment required for performing cleaning operation
arrange protective gear like thick cleaning gloves, close toe-non slip footwear, head cover, and masks or goggles, if required
collect the waste carefully in proper waste disposal bags without any spillage
clean the waste bins regularly
ensure that carry bags are placed on waste bins after cleaning
take the trolley/bin to the assigned waste disposal area
carry out the cleaning procedures in the correct sequence (e.g. sweeping, dusting, mopping/vacuum cleaning, disinfecting, and air freshening)
handle cleaning agents without spilling in the assigned area to be cleaned
clean and polish the surface without causing any damage to the surfaces
choose correct method of clearing up the spillage in accordance with/as per the floor and the size and type of spillage
use appropriate signages to notify that cleaning process is on or to mark wet floors etc.
complete the documentation accurately
report damage to the supervisor, if any
ensure proper functioning of equipment/appliances like ACs, hair dryer, TV, remotes, etc. in guest rooms
report to manager regarding any faulty equipment
ensure routine service and maintenance of cleaning equipment
collect soiled linen and other items like towels, bathrobes, etc. in trolley bag
arrange the items in the assigned area like flowers, paintings, linen/towel, guest stationery as per standard procedure
arrange the bed and other furniture in the assigned area as per hotel’s guidelines
make the bed with fresh linen, pillow cases, and bedside mat
replenish the bathroom supplies
handle guest requests such as extra pillows, beds, linen, towel, etc. to ensure guest satisfaction
contact F&B department to ensure timely service to the guests
report to the manager for any other requests outside of housekeeping
